chapter: Second day: early memories, London 1966 and other singers
title: Childhood stay in New Orleans
summary: As a small child she stayed briefly in New Orleans with her brother, while her mother tried to keep him from the war.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You were just a little child.
How long do you think you lived there when you were a child?
I was there with my brother about two (unintelligible), not long.
Because, you know, my father was (unintelligible).
Mama had to carry my brother to (unintelligible) keep my brother from going to the war.
He say he had to take care of his mother and his sister.
And we were small children, well, he said for Mama to come up there to New Orleans and stay with him a little while. But I can't remember just how long we
And then you went back to Texas?
